limits: Each resource read still computes a fresh full-source SHA-256. These changes reduce body retention, repeat scans/copies and Base64 processing; they do not remove the full-file hash input per page.
Binary response.blob() still receives the complete bounded file. Shared preview consumers may construct a byte array from that Blob.
Local File reuse is disposable and requires Host binding/availability/generation confirmation; refresh, another device, cache eviction or changed content falls back to Host reading.
Native platform qualification remains macOS arm64 only; Chrome mobile viewport simulation does not qualify physical iOS/Android devices.
